newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Wednesday, as profit-taking following recent price gains put a lid on further gains, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 1.1 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark July was down 0.3 yen at 158.8 yen. Volume was 11,840 lots.

During the day, the market started the day on a firmer tone, and the yen's further drop added bullishness to the market. "Private investors were returning to the market. If overseas markets continue to firm, prices here are likely to edge up further," one trader said.
